blocks.orig: Arusha Planet Lodge is a beautiful lodge in Arusha, located in a lush tropical garden not too far from Arusha’s city center. The lodge boasts 34 rooms in traditional rondavels with a modern twist, 2 of which are wheelchair accessible and 4 interconnected for families. The swimming pool is the ideal place to relax with a tasty drink, while the in-house restaurant offers delicious food, making this a great place to start or finish your safari.
blocks.html: Arusha Planet Lodge is a lovely lodge set in a lush tropical garden in Arusha, a short distance from Arusha’s city centre. It has 34 rooms in traditional rondavels with a modern touch; 2 are wheelchair accessible and 4 are connected for families. Relax at the swimming pool with a tasty drink, and enjoy good food at the lodge's own restaurant, which makes it a fine place to begin or end your safari.
